source.license_note: No repository license declared; source equations and parameters are re-expressed; no upstream source code copied

adaptation.observation: exact full state (time,y,z) before each action
adaptation.missing_observation_policy: unsupported; missing observations do not reveal or reconstruct hidden state
adaptation.controller_reset: fresh stateless policy and initial state per disturbance history
adaptation.warm_start: none; each finite enumeration restarts from its authored plan catalogue
adaptation.decision_order: observe full state; select u; apply current v; advance
adaptation.moving_horizon_prediction: source dynamics continue beyond scored episode endpoint
adaptation.tie_selector: first plan in authored action order within 1e-12 absolute objective tolerance
adaptation.deadline_enforcement: reject a solve that returns after the deadline; current finite_action_minimax call is not interruptible
adaptation.fallback: apply u=0 after timeout/solver failure, count the decision, continue the episode
adaptation.stability_scope: finite episode outcomes only; no recursive feasibility or stability theorem

objective.planning: terminal squared max-coordinate objective; zero nominal disturbance or finite min-max

scope: finite-action, four-step source-derived adaptation; not a reproduction of the continuous-action four-second RL task; finite disturbance histories only
